paper.title: Extended Beta Regression in R: Shaken, Stirred, Mixed, and Partitioned

code.commit: CRAN archive tarball betareg_3.0-0.tar.gz, DESCRIPTION Version 3.0-0, Date 2012-05-09
code.archive: sha256 8e021999a8647ee5d7b23cf1e6be3f60a68a2b72102d0f7852c23a3568831df3 (downloaded by scout 2026-11-26 from the CRAN archive; GPL-2). The paper cites betareg 2.4-0 onward for BC/BR; 3.0-0 is the closest archived release to the 2012 paper, and the rerun should record the release it uses.
code.note: The GasolineYield data set ships inside the archived package (data/GasolineYield.rda), so no external download is needed. The paper's R listing (p. 23) is the code to implement: data("GasolineYield", package = "betareg"); gy <- lapply(c("ML", "BC", "BR"), function(x) betareg(yield ~ batch + temp, data = GasolineYield, type = x)); sapply(gy, logLik).

stack: R (current release), with the archived betareg 3.0-0 and its dependencies (Formula, flexmix, lmtest, modeltools, sandwich)

claim.location: Section on the gasoline yield example, JSS p. 23 (the text 'the log-likelihood does not change much' followed by the R listing sapply(gy, logLik)), printed output '[1] 84.79756 82.94707 82.94499'.
claim.paper_value: log-likelihood of the ML fit, betareg(yield ~ batch + temp, data = GasolineYield, type = "ML"): 84.79756
claim.value_check: Read by scout from the JSS PDF (pdftotext -layout of v48i11.pdf) on 2026-11-26: the printed line '[1] 84.79756 82.94707 82.94499' is on page 23, and the same ML value 84.79756 is repeated in the second R listing (sapply(gy2, logLik), with the '| 1' precision formula, giving 84.79756 for ML) on page 24's Table 2 companion code.
claim.metric: log-likelihood (logLik) of the type = "ML" betareg fit, the first element of sapply(gy, logLik) for the gasoline yield data

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run: the printed value has five decimals, and an ML optimum on the same data should agree to optimizer precision across platforms. Pass if |logLik - 84.79756| <= 0.001. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute: three betareg fits on 32 observations.
cost.data_size: Small: GasolineYield (32 rows) inside the betareg package.
cost.data_licence: No external data. betareg is GPL-2.

why: A deterministic (no seed) maximum-likelihood value printed to five decimals in an R JSS paper, reproducible in seconds from the archived package and its bundled data.
